items.title: Old Dominion’s tonnage turns positive; recovery needs demand inflection
items.content_html:
Old Dominion reported positive tonnage growth in September for the first time in more than two years, but company executives emphasized that returning to upcycle-level performance likely requires a wider recovery in demand, which relies on easing energy costs.
